title: Avoid rebuilding contiguous dictionary history for each small block
description: encode.rs copies the prefix and plaintext into history; block.rs preloads dictionary bytes before reconstruction. Compare segmented history or reusable prefixed storage against that baseline, keeping the match finder and overlap semantics intact.
acceptance_criteria: Measure copied bytes and throughput for small blocks with large dictionaries and for dictionary-free controls. Cover matches crossing from dictionary to output, overlapping matches, concatenated frames and ID zero. Check exact archive bytes and reference decode.
notes:
Baseline: 65,535-byte prefix copied per 4 KiB block on encode and decode (16 B/B); 0.125 B/B at 512 KiB. First follow-up: use cargo xtask ledger and compare uninstrumented intervals; keep dictionary indexing cost distinct from copying. See doc/profiling/ledger.md.
Sol high is implementing the decode-only experiment: borrow dictionary match history and measure 4 KiB single-worker latency against a 10% improvement threshold, with 512 KiB and dictionary-free controls. Encoder work remains open.
Decode half shipped in 5d0d8d81. Ledger confirms zero full-prefix preload. Two 4 KiB runs: ~79% lower single-worker latency, 16.5–29.4% lower at four workers. 512 KiB four-worker result inconclusive. Workspace tests and pinned C interop passed. Remaining scope: measure encoder prefix copying vs per-block prefix indexing. Evidence: doc/profiling/dictionary-decode.md (a2265bc2).
Resumed the same Sol high session for encoder measurements: distinguish dictionary copy, prefix indexing and hash-table reset costs; compare warm/cold encode, worker counts and pre-change archive bytes.
close_reason: Decode no longer preloads the dictionary. Encode now caches the dominant repeated prefix-index work: warmed 4 KiB encode took ~90% less time single-worker and ~89% less with four. Retains 256 KiB per warmed dictionary shared across workers; contiguous history copy remains, measured at 1.3–1.5 µs/block versus 118–119 µs for indexing. Reference bytes, C interop and 38 workspace tests passed. See doc/profiling/dictionary-encode.md.

title: Measure and cut redundant byte traffic across codec, I/O and component boundaries
description: Follow a byte from input to sink for serial, parallel, indexed and Wasm workloads. Rank avoidable whole-block and repeated per-section passes, including ones hidden behind adapters or allocation growth. PivCo copy-back is already tracked by zxcrs-simd-scratch.
acceptance_criteria: Publish reproducible bytes moved per plaintext byte and uninstrumented throughput baselines; record keep/drop decisions for the dominant sites. Preserve checksum-before-publication, bounded memory, serial archive identity, C interoperability and WIT semantics.

title: Build a reproducible byte-movement ledger for representative paths
description: Add opt-in per-stage counters or benchmark probes. Separate actual payload copies, required output materialization, zero-fill, allocation growth and allocator-capacity reuse. A Vec move/swap is not a payload copy. Label inferred traffic separately from counted bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Provide a runnable report over RAW/noise, wide Huffman, dense mixed, small dictionary blocks and range reads at 4 KiB and 512 KiB where applicable; include native serial/parallel and a WIT comparison. Rank sites by bytes per plaintext byte and pair with uninstrumented Criterion intervals.
close_reason: Completed cargo xtask ledger --component across 36 cases with counters disabled for timing; 23 targeted tests passed. Ranked results and reproduction: doc/profiling/ledger.md and ledger-5800x.tsv (75f676db). Largest measured full-frame payload copy: dictionary prefix, 16 B/B at 4 KiB.

title: Compare scalar, table-driven and fearless_simd bitmap merges
description: In entropy.rs::Tree::decode use a 256-entry mask table to select eight bytes from two child streams. Compare the existing cursor loop, scalar lookup and optional fearless_simd u8x16 dynamic shuffle. Choose the dispatch point outside the inner loop.
acceptance_criteria: Check every mask, short/exhausted children and tail widths against scalar with no out-of-bounds load. Record kernel and whole-archive intervals on two entropy inputs and the run length where the shuffle pays off.
notes: Sol high is comparing the existing scalar merge, mask-table scalar and safe SIMD kernels on the retained buffer layout. Scratch experiment recorded in doc/profiling/pivco-scratch.md.
close_reason: 561fe398 and 40155aaa: measured scalar table and optional fearless_simd merge on native and WIT. Wide native decode ~119 → 73 → 49 µs. Confirmed i8x16.swizzle, exact WIT outputs, no SIMD requirement on default component and reported artifact sizes. Both native builds passed 41 tests and pinned C interop. See doc/profiling/pivco-merge.md.

title: Parallelize verified decode of streamed and concatenated frames
description: Dispatch validated blocks with frame-local dictionary and checksum seed. Enforce output limits and commit errors in stream order.
acceptance_criteria: Plaintext matches sequential output across concatenated C fixtures; a bad block emits no bytes from that block or later blocks. Failing sinks terminate without deadlock.
close_reason: Bounded parallel implementation, ordered failure tests and CLI integrated. Five backends passed the generated C oracle and serial archive identity checks.

title: Parallelize encoding while preserving serial archive bytes
description: Submit independent blocks, sharing encoder logic; keep frame-local index, seek groups and digest in order.
acceptance_criteria: Serial and parallel emit identical bytes for all modes, short reads, dictionaries, checksum and seekable combinations; upstream C decodes them.
close_reason: Bounded parallel implementation, ordered failure tests and CLI integrated. Five backends passed the generated C oracle and serial archive identity checks.

title: Ship memory-bounded parallel streaming with interchangeable transports
description: Build a sibling driver over the serial codec. Bound every block from admission before read through ordered write. Compare transports behind the same API and slot budget. Design: doc/architecture/indexed-execution.md.
acceptance_criteria: Encode/decode on pipes and files with deterministic output, bounded in-flight work and reliable error shutdown; expose worker count and document a measured backend choice.

title: Implement slot admission and ordered commit in a parallel driver crate
description: Use scoped workers with private scratch and crossbeam-channel as the first adapter. Hold permits through queued, executing and completed-but-unwritten states. Keep transport types out of codec and component APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Force the first job to finish last. Assert no more than K blocks are admitted and all results commit in input order. Fail source, worker and writer paths with blocked participants and show every worker joins.
close_reason: Bounded parallel implementation, ordered failure tests and CLI integrated. Five backends passed the generated C oracle and serial archive identity checks.

title: Read indexed ZXC ranges without scanning unrelated blocks
description: Separate archive navigation into zxc-seek while reusing wire and block verification from the serial codec. See doc/architecture/indexed-execution.md.
acceptance_criteria: Extract archive-relative byte ranges across blocks and frames; validate touched entries and compare bytes to independent C fixtures.
close_reason: zxc-seek, zxc info and zxc range shipped in c52aa7c4. Cross-implementation and indexed-read verification passed.

title: Share verified block decode and navigate seek groups on demand
description: Walk frame footers backwards over a positioned source; load only touched groups and resolve dictionaries per frame.
acceptance_criteria: Counting-source tests exclude unrelated payload reads across group 63→64 and concatenated frames; reject forged entries and checksum failures.
close_reason: c52aa7c4; upstream fixture, counting-source, dictionary, corruption and group/frame boundary tests pass.

title: Encode and decode version 9 frames and dictionaries in Rust
description: Support RAW, PAK, SPL, PivCo, checksums, dictionaries, concatenation and seek-table writing.
acceptance_criteria: Decode all upstream valid fixtures and interoperate in split, packed and dense modes.
close_reason: dc1e8202 and 038ee384 implement the serial codec and dense encoder; reference plaintexts and two-way interop pass.

title: Ship the interoperable native ZXC v9 streaming codec
description: Deliver the safe Rust library and streaming CLI against hellobertrand/zxc at 2992c28. Scope: serial codec baseline; indexed reads have their own epic. See doc/architecture/README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Encode and decode with the C reference in both directions; demonstrate malformed-input rejection and CLI output safety.
close_reason: Serial codec, CLI and compatibility gates shipped. The 180 cross-decoding checks also passed at indexed-reader integration.

title: Test a faster wide-Huffman decode loop on both backends
description: Tree::decode accounted for 83.3% of sampled guest user cycles on upstream-l7/decode. Inspect native and guest captures before changing the bit reader or lookup path in crates/codec/src/entropy.rs.
acceptance_criteria: Save before/after Criterion intervals for all three paths on the fixed archive and a second entropy workload; run valid/invalid conformance and C interop; document whether to keep the change.

title: Measure and tune the codec on native and Wasm paths
description: Use shared inputs and named baselines to distinguish codec improvements from workspace reuse and WIT transfer costs. Start with the measured entropy decode hotspot. Measurement home: doc/profiling/README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce paired baselines, locate hotspots on both backends, and record decisions from targeted decode and encode experiments against representative inputs.

title: Cut scalar, SIMD128 and relaxed SIMD WIT bundles and compare decode
description: Build three same-interface Wasm artifacts, validate ISA requirements, exercise all under Wasmtime and compare repeated wide, mixed and RAW timings.
close_reason: Cut three same-interface components; all-mode WIT checks passed. Confirmed strict/relaxed swizzle opcodes. In paired Wasmtime runs SIMD128 was faster than relaxed on both entropy cases; prefer SIMD128 on this host. See doc/profiling/pivco-merge.md.

title: Attribute host/guest list transfers and guest buffer staging
description: Trace a WIT call in both directions, distinguishing canonical ABI transfers from extra copies made by bindings, host helpers or guest codec entry points. Use paired native and Wasmtime benchmarks.
acceptance_criteria: Report attributable bytes and transfer cost by payload size with a no-codec or equivalent control. Prototype a compatible ownership improvement if one is measurable; document any API change separately.

title: Verify buffer reuse across worker, reorder and writer handoffs
description: Track backing buffers across encode.rs/block.rs swaps, worker completion, pending slots and in-order writes. Audit reallocations after warm-up and compare the Rayon batch path. Do not count channel movement of Vec handles as byte copying.
acceptance_criteria: Report bytes copied and capacities retained per slot and worker for RAW/mixed blocks, including a slow head. Hold worker/slot budgets fixed; preserve ordered cancellation, serial identity and memory bounds.

title: Reduce staging on repeated in-memory and file range reads
description: Slice ReadAt copies into a block body and each copy_range call owns scratch. Evaluate borrowed archive slices or a reusable range-reader session; compare with positioned file reads.
acceptance_criteria: Report copied/read bytes per requested byte for tiny, aligned and cross-block ranges. Distinguish full-block checksum/decode requirements from avoidable staging. Keep counting-source, forged-entry and concurrent read tests passing.

title: Audit block input, RAW passthrough and output buffering
description: Compare memory slices, file and pipe paths through frame.rs and the CLI. Identify redundant staging or zero-fill before read_exact, BufReader/BufWriter bypass and any benefit of borrowed or caller-owned buffers.
acceptance_criteria: Separate kernel/user transfers, required writes and redundant user-space passes. Benchmark both small/large blocks and partial I/O; preserve byte limits, short reads and checksum-before-write.

title: Reduce staging between entropy decode and LZ reconstruction
description: Trace RLE/Huffman literals and tokens from section expansion through block.rs reconstruction. Compare reusable section destinations or direct placement where ordering permits. PivCo internal merge copy-back belongs to zxcrs-simd-scratch.
acceptance_criteria: Measure section bytes materialized versus bytes written to final output, peak scratch and decode speed on RLE, inline and shared Huffman fixtures. Preserve checksums, malformed-section rejection and LZ overlap behavior.

title: Avoid building and copying a second complete dense payload
description: Measure raw section assembly, entropy candidate materialization and dense.extend_from_slice in encode.rs and entropy/pack.rs. Try pricing sections first and serializing the winner once, or reusing final storage.
acceptance_criteria: Report bytes staged for winning and rejected candidates, peak scratch and encode rate on RAW fallback and entropy-friendly data. Preserve mode decisions, padding and archive identity.

title: Validate a Wasm simd128 kernel through the shipped WIT interface
description: Build an opt-in SIMD component alongside the scalar component. Inspect emitted Wasm and compare the same decode cases through Wasmtime, including the cost of WIT transfer.
acceptance_criteria: Verify actual SIMD instructions, unchanged WIT semantics, scalar-host compatibility of the baseline artifact, module-size delta and end-to-end intervals on two payloads.
close_reason: 561fe398 and 40155aaa: measured scalar table and optional fearless_simd merge on native and WIT. Wide native decode ~119 → 73 → 49 µs. Confirmed i8x16.swizzle, exact WIT outputs, no SIMD requirement on default component and reported artifact sizes. Both native builds passed 41 tests and pinned C interop. See doc/profiling/pivco-merge.md.

title: Measure and reduce copying between PivCo merge levels
description: Reuse scratch or alternate source and destination buffers to avoid a full copy-back for each mixed node. Isolate memory traffic from the shuffle optimization.
acceptance_criteria: Compare allocation/copy volume and throughput with the same merge kernel. Repeat at one worker and multiple workers; check block-local scratch isolation and exact plaintext.
notes: Sol high continued from the dictionary experiments to isolate scalar Huffman merge copy-back, testing native and component workloads against the prior ledger baseline.
close_reason: Closed with a measured drop decision in 0635580d. Alternating buffers removed 3.97 B/B of wide-Huffman copy-back with unchanged peak auxiliary scratch, but neither entropy-heavy input had a repeatable native serial speedup, and the 4 KiB dense mixed workload regressed 11.1–12.8% through WIT. Paired benchmarks, capacity probes and tests retained; see doc/profiling/pivco-scratch.md.

title: Try vector unpacking of PivCo flat subtrees
description: Measure time by subtree depth and specialize only the frequent packed widths, using byte extraction/shuffle plus symbol lookup. Start with depths 2–4.
acceptance_criteria: Compare scalar and vector output for every supported width and byte alignment including truncated and final runs. Record which widths improve whole-archive performance.

title: Evaluate SIMD kernels for native and Wasm codec workloads
description: Start with the measured PivCo hotspot. On the 1,000-frame wide-Huffman input upstream C took 28.6 ms with explicit kernels and 82.8 ms without; this is motivation, not a predicted Rust speedup. Evidence: doc/profiling/README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Record keep/drop decisions per candidate. Compare whole-archive throughput on the wide fixture and a second representative input; retain scalar fallback, valid/invalid conformance and generated C interop for adopted kernels.

title: Cross-decode replayable generated plaintexts with the pinned C and Rust binaries
description: Extend cargo xtask interop past the fixed corpus with independently seeded recipes, block/group/frame boundaries and dictionaries. Design: doc/testing/generated-interop.md.
acceptance_criteria: Both producers cross-decode to original plaintext; indexed ranges from both match original slices. Preserve failing bytes and replay one seed/case without the frozen suite.
close_reason: 95017a0b: generated two-way checks and both-producer ranges pass for the scheduled cases; injected /bin/false failure confirms CLI overrides, seed/case replay and retained artifacts.

title: Compare bounded transports and a Rayon batch baseline on codec workloads
description: Compare crossbeam-channel, flume, kanal and crossfire adapters, plus fixed-batch Rayon, with the same input, worker count, slot budget and chunk size. Use the existing profiling harness and real corpus.
acceptance_criteria: Record throughput, peak resident memory, time waiting for slots/ordered output and cancellation behavior. Publish a reproducible default recommendation, including negative results.
notes: All five backends implemented, generated C interop and Criterion comparisons passed. Initial synthetic comparison documented in doc/profiling/README.md. Representative-corpus, peak RSS and wait-time comparisons remain.

title: Expose parallel streaming through --threads
description: Wire worker-count selection into encode, decode and test for files and pipes; keep one worker on the serial path.
acceptance_criteria: Document worker count and memory policy, verify flags and serial equivalence, and preserve named-output no-clobber on parallel failure.
close_reason: Bounded parallel implementation, ordered failure tests and CLI integrated. Five backends passed the generated C oracle and serial archive identity checks.

title: Expose indexed info and range commands and test C archives
description: Use archive-relative plaintext offsets; retain named-output commit semantics and seed an indexed fuzz target.
acceptance_criteria: Check output boundaries, no partial named files and range results against freshly generated C archives.
close_reason: c52aa7c4; CLI tests, 72 C-generated range checks and a 2000-run indexed fuzz smoke test passed.

title: Attribute native codec phases with direct Tracy captures
description: Compile phase zones out by default and document a protocol-matched capture. See doc/profiling/README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Capture a real workload and verify a resulting optimization with uninstrumented throughput.
notes: cargo xtask tracy now reproduces the 1,000-frame capture in one command; verified 6,000 zones using Tracy 0.14.1. See doc/profiling/README.md.
close_reason: Tracy 0.14.1 isolated PivCo; 45511ad2 changed to bottom-up merging and the wide fixture rose from about 30 to 132 MiB/s. Paired Wasm tuning remains under zxcrs-perf-entropy.

title: Gate the port on upstream conformance and two-way C decoding
description: Pin the upstream fixtures; exercise independent C encoding and decoding. Seed roundtrip and decode fuzzing.
acceptance_criteria: Cover all 18 valid and 35 invalid fixtures under the sequential contract, and compare plaintext in both directions.
notes: cargo xtask interop now builds the pinned C oracle and is used by CI; 180 cross-decoding + 72 range checks passed. cargo xtask fuzz-smoke ran 2,000 iterations for each target.
close_reason: 91f40585 vendors the corpus; CI, fuzz targets and the 180-case C interop gate are in place.

title: Ship encode, decode and integrity-test CLI commands
description: Make the serial library usable with pipes, files and explicit dictionaries.
acceptance_criteria: Do not clobber named output or publish partial named results after verification failure.
close_reason: dc1e8202; crates/cli/tests/files.rs verifies failure and no-clobber behavior.

title: Publish a verifiable bundle on a version tag
description: CI artifacts are available per workflow run. Define the tag-to-WIT version check and package the validated component with its contract, license, revision and checksum for a durable download.
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run packaging and checksum verification; the tag workflow checks the WIT version and tests the exact downloadable bytes before publication.

title: Exercise the release bundle from an independent component host
description: The typed benchmark currently uses Wasmtime. Load the CI bundle from a second consumer, e.g. a JS host via jco, using its published WIT rather than codec internals.
acceptance_criteria: Document a runnable consumer that round-trips bytes, decodes a pinned upstream fixture, and observes a max-output error; exercise it in CI.

title: Attribute dense encoder costs before optimizing them
description: Mixed/Dense/b19/encode had distributed costs: __multi3 15.9%, Tree::new 14.4%, heap pop 12.1% in the component capture. Identify callers and compare native before selecting one optimization.
acceptance_criteria: Report attribution on mixed input and a real corpus, compare three-way timing and archive sizes, and record a keep/reject decision with conformance results.
notes: Sol medium is reproducing identical dense/split dickens archives and tracing both literal and token candidate rejection. Require a targeted regression and C interop for the fix.
close_reason: Diagnosed unconstrained Huffman trees being discarded above depth 11. Length-limited package-merge now prices a valid candidate for both streams. dickens dense 6,103,312 -> 4,679,837 B; sao 6,386,860 -> 6,140,199 B. Targeted regression and pinned C interop pass. See doc/profiling/dense-huffman.sol.md.

title: Make real-corpus baseline comparisons reproducible
description: Extend the existing ZXC_BENCH_INPUT workflow with a reproducible selection of redistributable or hash-pinned external inputs. Capture revision, CPU, compiler/runtime versions, flags, corpus hash, sizes and uncertainty alongside results.
acceptance_criteria: Another checkout can reproduce at least one text and one binary comparison from documented inputs and distinguish environment or corpus changes from codec changes.
notes:
First pinned text/binary native CLI scorecard: doc/profiling/upstream-silesia.md. Next: promote the comparison to xtask, include in-memory single-worker timings and validate on the full corpus.
Terra high is implementing the upstream scorecard against a frozen pre-fix Rust baseline, independently of the dense investigation.
close_reason: 2096ad98 adds the pinned Silesia CLI scorecard, raw sample metadata and separate API probes. All 12 corpus files passed 96 cross-decodes on frozen binaries. Post-dense subset also passed on the rebuilt Rust binary.

title: Export the codec through WIT and deliver a CI bundle
description: Retrospective. Build the import-free zxc:codec/buffers@0.1.0 component from wit-bindgen and bundle the component, WIT, and license via cargo xtask component.
acceptance_criteria: Validate the component; instantiate its typed exports; verify round trips, an upstream archive, and the output limit; configure CI artifact upload.
close_reason: Implemented in 4f13941 and 861fd67; migrated to Rust xtask in 115e862 and f9ae1e9. wasm-tools validated the bundle and typed Wasmtime calls passed the all-mode smoke suite.

title: Capture native and Wasmtime hotspots from Rust xtask
description: Retrospective. Record an exact Criterion case, inject JIT symbols for component captures, and optionally retain line tables and record DWARF call stacks. See xtask/src/main.rs and doc/profiling/README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Verify both backends with and without --dwarf, keep shipping artifacts separate, and document actual symbol and line resolution.
close_reason: Implemented and exercised Linux perf and jitdump; 06a7c94 and aca4975 verified opt-in DWARF: native source lines resolved, injected guest symbols resolved to function offsets. Shipping component checksum unchanged.

title: Benchmark matched native and WIT calls with Criterion
description: Retrospective. Shared fixtures and mode/block/input controls drive native reused-workspace, native one-shot, and warm typed component cases. cargo xtask compare selects one exact workload and supports named baselines. See tests/bench_inputs.rs and doc/profiling/README.md#compare-native-and-component.
acceptance_criteria: Exercise all modes on both backends; save and document a three-way baseline; CI smoke-runs both suites.
close_reason: Shipped in 7eb3b73, 37d54a6, 893fce9 and f9ae1e9. Verified 38 native + 19 component cases. For upstream-l7/decode, 100 samples/path yielded 132.1 / 132.5 / 113.5 MiB/s on the 5800X. See doc/profiling/README.md; session ses_e0b145b97ffeZCgqrI2NHSkUTX.

title: Ship a versioned WIT codec component that independent hosts can consume
description: Carry the dictionary-free buffer codec from its WIT contract through a validated bundle to a reproducible consumer test. Contract: crates/component/wit/codec.wit; distribution: README.md#webassembly-component.
acceptance_criteria: Build and exercise the same versioned bundle from CI, a tagged release, and an independent consumer.

title: Test wider encoder match extension where profiles justify it
description: Separate hash-table lookup cost from byte comparisons on noisy input, long repeats and near-matches. Try vector byte equality plus first-mismatch detection if comparison is significant.
acceptance_criteria: Measure against the existing word-wise extension, including near-end and overlapping matches. Require serial archive identity, unchanged size, and a documented keep/drop decision on end-to-end encode throughput.

title: Compare native x86 byte shuffles and ARM NEON dispatch
description: For a promising portable kernel, inspect generated instructions and compare runtime dispatch at block or section scope with a forced scalar path. Consider ISA-specific specialization only when the portable lowering leaves measurable performance on the table.
acceptance_criteria: Check scalar fallback and tail equivalence. Report timings on available real CPUs, distinguishing cross-compilation from measured results; record dispatch overhead on short runs.

title: Explore Loom model checking for slot ownership and ordered shutdown
description: Model the parallel driver protocol with Loom synchronization, two workers and two in-flight slots. Reuse the driver state transitions where practical; fake the codec work. Exercise a delayed first block and cancellation while a producer or writer is waiting. Keep this an optional development test.
acceptance_criteria: Document the command and exploration bounds. Check ordered, at-most-once commit, return of all permits, and termination after failure across explored schedules. Show the test catches a deliberately broken transition. Real channel adapters remain covered by integration tests.

title: Measure WIT call cost across payload sizes and cold starts
description: Warm whole-buffer calls hide startup and mix codec work with canonical ABI transfers. Use a size sweep and a benchmark-only byte-list control to guide any batching or workspace-resource proposal.
acceptance_criteria: Report warm latency and throughput against native one-shot; separately report compilation/instantiation and first-call latency. Recommend whether an API change merits a prototype.
